items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: Another trumpet player I used to like was Walter Fuller in Earl Hines' band. I used to listen to him a lot.

ctx.x: Another trumpet player I used to like was Walter Fuller in Earl Hines' band. I used to listen to him a lot. See, out in California I didn't have too much choice of who I could hear. There was a good trumpet player, Don Redman had a good trumpet -- I think it was Red Allen, made a tune called "Shaking the African". And it starts off with this wild solo (humming). And then Don Redman sings. God, he was -- what a giant he was. And he wound up in the union being a sergeant at arms or something, dumb thing.
